sources.title: Trading desk VPN drops at market open
paragraphs: The trading desk VPN drops for a few seconds at market open when the tunnel renegotiates its keys.
Lower the tunnel rekey interval on the firewall and confirm the desk stays connected through the open.
Reference phrase for this article: quokka-fabrikam-canary-4410.

sources.title: Statement export mismatch
paragraphs: The quarterly statement export drops rows when the date filter spans a holiday.
Example from a past ticket: investor Alder Whitfield, account 00-1234-5678 showed a short statement.
Re-run the export with the filter split at the holiday.
